descriptionPlain:
Autonomous vehicles have some of the largest, most complex software ever shipped in a safety-critical environment. Solving that problem is one of the most exciting technical challenges of our lifetime.
 
As an Autonomy Systems Test Engineer at Zoox, you will help accelerate our product development by helping our developers build the safest and most reliable autonomous driving software possible. As developers build new features, you will oversee the development of extensive test plans, develop standardized simulated test design tooling processes to execute many different scenarios and put together triage pipelines for analyzing issues seen during offline and on-vehicle testing. These efforts are critical to exposing unforeseen failure modes, implementation bugs, and other issues as a result of new feature development. You will participate regularly in in-vehicle testing missions where you will see these new features behaving in the real world. Following these missions, you will help triage and root cause issues seen during testing, analyze test results to ensure existing functionality does not regress from release to release, and update our testing processes to ensure QA can continue scaling efficiently with future Zoox milestones. Your ability to distill complex systems and root cause issues will be critical to producing a safe and stable vehicle platform.

lists.content:
• Create test strategies and test plans for Zoox’s self-driving behavior features.

  • Identify, track, report, and resolve test strategy, planning, or implementation issues with cross-functional software development teams

  • Propose, prototype, and validate a new testing methodology for driving software features using automated metrics.

  • Design, develop, and execute synthetic and log-based test scenarios on an in-house simulation test framework

  • Compile triage strategy and triage results from different QA validation platforms and pipelines 

  • Lead cross-functional QA participation in various testing pipelines, initiatives, and enablement projects.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field
  • 3+ years of experience in designing and implementing scalable software systems test strategies with excellent analytical, problem-solving, and prioritization skills
  • Proficiency with automated test framework and test automation
  • Experience with JIRA, GIT, Linux command line, Python, or other scripting languages
  • Strong organizational, leadership, and communication skills

    •

• Relevant industry experience in software and systems testing for robotics, autonomous mobility, or safety-critical systems.
  • Familiarity with ISO 26262 or other safety standards
  • Proficiency with Claude Code or other AI coding tools

descriptionPlain:
As a CNC Programmer at Zoox, you'll interface with a broad range of Engineers and Craftspeople to build hardware systems for our Vehicle, Compute, Sensor, and testing fleets. Core values include a positive outlook, good interpersonal skills, and a desire to affect a company genuinely trying to change the world. Familiarity with names like Hermle, DMG Mori, Siemens, Heidenhain, Lang, Haimer, and Robotic Solutions will give you a head start at Zoox. 
 
Your experience in a professional and well-equipped CNC shop and positive outlook in a team environment will serve equally well on the path to success. Our team encompasses everything from prototyping to manufacturing operations. Career growth will be at your disposal. We serve an entire company and often volunteer to step outside our disciplines to help all who ask. If this sounds like the position you're looking for, we look forward to meeting you.

descriptionPlain: Zoox is looking for an embedded software engineer to join our Firmware Power Systems team. Responsibilities include designing, building, and testing real-time embedded code in C/C++ for BMS (Battery Management Systems). Key responsibilities include implementing safety algorithms, managing board bring-up, and ensuring seamless hardware-software integration. The work includes Power management and efficiency, Charging control, a variety of operator controls, integration of supplier systems, coordination and control of all Power sub-systems, and low-level vehicle controls. This work requires collaboration with vehicle engineers, systems engineers, controls engineers, and suppliers to ensure the Zoox vehicle can drive safely and reliably. We are looking for people who are passionate about working with hardware and developing production-quality code for complex dynamic systems.

Key responsibilities include implementing safety algorithms, managing board bring-up, and ensuring seamless hardware-software integration. The work includes Power management and efficiency, Charging control, a variety of operator controls, integration of supplier systems, coordination and control of all Power sub-systems, and low-level vehicle controls. lists.content:
• Design, develop, and test embedded software for BMS (Battery Management Systems of the Zoox vehicle

  • Implement core logic for cell balancing, charging control, thermal management, and contactor controls.

  • Integrate supplier sub-systems into the Zoox software stack

  • Create software requirements, design documentation, test plans, and other supporting documentation

  • Work cross-functionally with vehicle engineers, controls engineers, software engineers, validation engineers, and other experts to ensure a seamless and highly automated experience for the Zoox vehicle

  • Contribute to all phases of the software development cycle including prototyping, requirements capture, design, implementation, and validation

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or equivalent experience
  • 8+ years of experience developing real-time embedded software for Power Electronics and Battery Management.

  • Strong embedded C/C++ programming experience

  • Experience with embedded micro-controllers and/or microprocessors (ARM, PowerPC)

  • Hands-on experience with hardware bring-up and system debugging

  • Understanding of sensors and actuators and automotive communication protocols (CAN, LIN)

• Basic knowledge of control systems for electromechanical systems

  • Experience with CAN, LIN analysis, and debugging tools (PCAN, CANalyzer, CANape, etc.)

  • Familiarity with high assurance development practices and tools (Polarion, ISO-26262, MISRA C/C++, etc)

description:
About Zoox

Zoox is an autonomous ridehailing company building the world's first purpose-built robotaxi — fully electric, bidirectional, with no steering wheel or driver's seat. Backed by Amazon and founded to make transportation safer, cleaner, and more accessible, Zoox designs its vehicles entirely around the rider. We're currently operating in Las Vegas and San Francisco, with Austin and Miami on the horizon, and testing underway across seven U.S. markets.

About Our Part-Time Student Worker Program

Zoox's part-time student worker program puts you at the center of one of the most ambitious challenges in transportation. You'll contribute to real projects, work alongside engineers and researchers pushing the boundaries of autonomous technology, and gain experience that goes well beyond the classroom. We're looking for students who bring strong academic foundations, curiosity that doesn't stop at coursework, and a drive to be part of something that matters.

lists.content: This role focuses on operational efficiency, building tools and dashboards, and conducting data verification and validation (V&V) for the Fleet- Operations team. The person will also work closely with the team to help drive operational efficiency across L3 programs.

• Application & Tool Development
  • Design and deploy internal mobile-first web applications to assist field operators with vehicle dispatch, routing, and end-of-shift reporting.
  • Build responsive user interfaces for real-time fleet monitoring, ensuring sub-second latency for tracking vehicle states and locations.

• Develop specialized diagnostic tools that translate complex vehicle telemetry and hardware sensor data into readable formats for non-technical operations staff.
  • [placeholder]
  • Workflow Automation
  • Architect automated ticketing systems to streamline maintenance requests, incident reporting, and vehicle recovery dispatches.

• Integrate AI-driven workflows to parse operational logs, identify recurring hardware or software faults, and automatically flag high-priority issues to engineering teams.
  • [placeholder]
  • Develop automated compliance trackers that cross-reference fleet operational zones with local municipal regulations to prevent routing violations.
  • Data Analytics & Dashboarding

• Construct live operational dashboards to visualize fleet health, downtime metrics, and operator efficiency metrics.
  • Currently enrolled in a B.S. or M.S. program in a relevant discipline.
  • Optimize database queries across NoSQL and SQL structures to ensure rapid retrieval of historical fleet data for weekly operational reviews.
  • Available to commit to a minimum three-month assignment.
  • Aggregate and analyze large sets of vehicle performance data to provide actionable recommendations for improving fleet utilization and reducing idle times.
  • Able to commit a minimum of 40 hours per week.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Able to work on-site at one of our office locations.
  • Interface directly with L3 hardware and software engineering teams to ensure operational tools accurately reflect the latest autonomous system capabilities and constraints.
  • Must adhere with Zoox confidentiality requirements, including refraining from using or sharing proprietary company information outside of Zoox, such as in academic research, theses, publications, or presentations.
  • Gather feedback from on-the-ground fleet operators to continuously iterate and improve the UX/UI of internal tools.
